**Plan, no edits made.**

`buildRows()` in [report.js](src/report.js) already gives full rows. `toTable` in [format.js:7](src/format.js:7) drops `owner` and `slow` on purpose, so JSON output would show more fields than the table. Worth confirming that's wanted.

1. Parse `--json` in [cli.js:9](src/cli.js:9).
2. If set, `JSON.stringify(buildRows())` instead of `toTable`.
3. No changes needed to `report.js` or `format.js`.

Say go and I'll make the edit.
